# Single-Use Video Flexible Ureterorenoscope (RP-U-C03R9, RP-U-C03R3, RP-U-C03S9, RP-U-C03S3); Endoscopic Video Image Processor (RP-IPD-V2000EF); Endoscopic Video Image Processor (RP-IPD-V1000F) — overview

## 产品与用途

The subject device trade name is Single-Use Video Flexible Ureterorenoscope (RP-U-C03R9, RP-U-C03R3, RP-U-C03S9, RP-U-C03S3); Endoscopic Video Image Processor (RP-IPD-V2000EF); Endoscopic Video Image Processor (RP-IPD-V1000F). [K251951:p5:c0]

The device is intended for endoscopy and endoscopic surgery within urinary tract and interior of the ureter and kidney, and has been developed to be used with endoscopic accessories and Endoscopic Video Image Processor. [K251951:p6:c0] [K251951:p6:c0]


## 设计与技术特征

状态：review_required

The supplied comparison text reports that the proposed device has an identical principle of operation, single use/reusability, white balance, brightness adjustment, working length, field of view, and direction of view to the predicate device, and that its minimum instrument channel width is extremely close to the predicate device. [K251951:p6:c1]

The same comparison text also states that the main configuration, dimension and weight, video signal output, zoom, OD of flexible insertion portion, maximum insertion portion width, bending angle, and depth of field of the proposed device are different to the predicate device. [K251951:p6:c1]

- Within the supplied excerpts, a detailed component-level list was not found; this draft is limited to the reported comparison statements.
- The quoted p8:c0 table excerpt does not explicitly identify proposed-device versus predicate-device value columns; therefore, numeric table values are not attributed to the subject device in the statements.
- The p8:c0 depth-of-field row shows a 3～50mm depth value with a tolerance stated as ± 10°; the intended unit or condition requires clarification.

## 使用条件与限制

状态：review_required

The Single-Use Video Flexible Ureterorenoscope is single-use and has a stated shelf life of 3 years; sterilization was validated in accordance with ISO 11135:2014. [K251951:p10:c0]

The device is intended to be used with endoscopic accessories and an Endoscopic Video Image Processor for endoscopy and endoscopic surgery within the urinary tract and the interior of the ureter and kidney. [K251951:p4:c0]

- The supplied source material does not include explicit warnings, contraindications, reusable-use instructions, or a defined patient population for the subject device.
- Absence of these details in the retrieved source text should not be treated as proof that the complete document lacks such information.

IV. Device Description Summary
The proposed device, Ureterorenoscope System, which includes a Single-Use Video Flexible
Ureterorenoscope, an Endoscopic Video Image Processor (model: RP-IPD-V2000EF) which has been
cleared under K241500 and an Endoscopic Video Image Processor (model: RP-IPD-V1000F) which
has been cleared under K243321 is intended for endoscopy and endoscopic surgery within urinary tract
and interior of the ureter and kidney.
V. Indications for use
The device has been developed to be used with endoscopic accessories and Endoscopic Video Image
Processor for endoscopy and endoscopic surgery within urinary tract and interior of the ureter and
kidney.
VI. Indications for Use Comparison
The indication for use (IFU) of the proposed device and the predicate device are similar. They have the
same principle of operation, and target location. Therefore, the difference in description does not affect
the safety and effectiveness of the proposed device.
